section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Zürich; other communes differ) and church tax
label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Zürich; other communes in Zürich set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Zürich)
label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
value: None: the canton and its municipalities levy no property tax
note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)

section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Zürich)
label: Property transfer tax (Handänderungssteuer)
value: None as such: only land registry or transfer fees are charged (amounts not stored)
note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
source_title: ESTV/SSK Dossier Steuerinformationen: Geltende Steuern (Stand der Gesetzgebung: 1. Januar 2026, June 2026)
